communication.evidence: For these headphones, a photo uploaded to the order is required before I can arrange the return. Our policy doesn’t specify an alternative when you can’t provide one, so I’ll refer your request to a human support agent for review. I can’t guarantee an exception or proceed with the refund without that review.

values.user_request: Customer requests an alternative way to proceed with a refund for broken headphones in order O0033 because they cannot upload or provide a photo during this conversation.
values.facts_found: User U040 verified using registered email; order O0033 belongs to U040. Wireless headphones item I0033, electronics, database item price ₹2,499, quantity 1. Delivered 2026-09-13 at 12:00 IST; today 2026-09-15, within inclusive 7-day electronics return window. Customer reports arrived broken; no safety issue reported. Shipping fee ₹49; original payment method UPI. Refund history read: no refunds in last 90 days, qualifying count 0, no prior order refunds. Potential eligible refund ₹2,548 including shipping, within ₹5,000 cumulative order limit. Photo status rechecked and remains false. Under standard process, return pickup required with no fee; system refunds automatically after completed pickup. No return or refund created and no explicit action confirmation obtained.
values.rule_triggered: E6 requires an uploaded photo for damage claims with item value above ₹2,000. A3 requires escalation for situations not covered by policy; no alternative evidence procedure or exception for inability to upload is specified. G3 facts gathered and summarized.
values.what_user_was_told: Explained ₹2,548 refund breakdown, original UPI refund method, free required pickup, automatic refund after pickup, and uploaded-photo prerequisite. Told customer the policy does not specify an alternative when unable to provide a photo, request is being referred to a human agent, and no exception or refund can be guaranteed without review.
